risks.title: Source uncertainty persists
risks.observation: MC08 arcs; MC11 actual O/I/inner geometry; CR04 AC/AD/covered proof; first relation = versus congruence; crest detail.
risks.mitigation: Keep source-proven alternatives, neutral blanks and explicit sidecar; actual human choice remains separate.

risks.title: Freshness contamination
risks.observation: Old source text/scene/delivered artifacts are available to the planner as metadata.
risks.mitigation: Production extractors receive source-only context and record input access; prior content is quarantined until fresh output freeze.

risks.title: Native runtime drift
risks.observation: Historical Hancom version, Python modules and COM success do not prove current readiness.
risks.mitigation: Re-observe installed tools after approval; no install or remote fallback; stop affected task on missing capability.

risks.title: Native equation/render differences
risks.observation: Old adapters include symbols later repaired, e.g. perpendicular/congruence/square mappings.
risks.mitigation: Do not execute early authoring adapter as-is. New task owns generic adapter and finite native controls, verified with actual output.

risks.title: Shared financial and hook state
risks.observation: PostToolUse changes semantic state; earlier explicit decision CLI returned JEV_RECEIPT_CONFLICT after durable decision storage.
risks.mitigation: Preserve raw receipts and costs; use consumed current explicit batch; fixed remaining planning artifacts have empty current profile. No old paid replay or configuration fix.

risks.title: Human approval not yet issued
risks.observation: No production approval or AcceptanceDecision exists.
risks.mitigation: Keep every production task held; Root pulls files; actual user response must bind packet digest.

risks.title: Diagram editability expectation
risks.observation: SVG/code regeneration and HWPX embedded PNG editability differ from native HWP shapes.
risks.mitigation: State exact editable boundary in approval packet and output manifest.

risks.title: Legacy holds and accounting liabilities
risks.observation: Pilot03 fulltext and exhausted historical recoveries/unknown liability remain.
risks.mitigation: New Work origin and account do not authorize old replay/release or a second allowance.
